svg.title: COAST architecture
svg.desc: Inputs feed a voxel map, then an A* and Safe Flight Corridor front end, then a minimum-snap quadratic program with MINVO bounds, producing B-spline control points. The multirotor flies the trajectory and the planner re-plans with each new scan.
svg.text: Multirotor tracks the spline · new scan → re-plan at 10 Hz
